title: Second restriction of the concrete binary submodule
statement: For any scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], opens $W,V$, module sheaves $H$ on $X$ and $Q$ on $V$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and any morphism $\iota:Q\to H|_V$, the concrete pullback $G$ of [def-weil-pbc-module-binary-submodule-pullback] restricts to a module isomorphic to $Q$ on $V$. No monicity or finiteness assumption is needed.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PF (lemma-extend), binary gluing paragraph; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PF

proof.text: For an open T contained in V, the site pullback projection T intersect V to T is an isomorphism: its inverse is the pullback lift of the identity and T to V. Thus the evaluated unit is bijective and is an isomorphism of modules. Evaluation preserves the module pullback, so its second projection is an isomorphism.

Compose the restricted second projection with the adjunction counit. The counit on a test open in V is restriction along the site adjunction unit, itself an isomorphism. Hence every component of this composite is an isomorphism. Assemble these component inverses via PresheafOfModules.isoMk and reflection by the forgetful functor.

proof_origin.note: Concrete Lean implementation of the cited gluing paragraph; local properties also follow Definitions 01BE and 01B5, read on the Stacks website.

lean.statement:
theorem binarySubmodule_on_V
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (Q : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))
    (ι : Q ⟶ H.over V) :
    Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (show V ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_right))).obj
          (binarySubmodule X W V H Q ι) ≅ Q)
